hook: Britannia's '100% whole wheat' bread had *62%* wheat. Fined *₹1 lakh*
tldr: The Central Consumer Protection Authority fined Britannia ₹1 lakh for advertising '100% whole wheat bread' when the pack declared 62% wheat content, and ordered the ad pulled across print, TV and social media. Britannia must file a compliance report in 15 days.

beats.what: CCPA's Oct 22 order calls the claim a misleading ad and orders it taken down immediately.
beats.why: CCPA acted on its own after spotting the 62% figure on the packaging. Britannia accepted the claim was inaccurate.
beats.care: Read the ingredients panel, not the front of the pack. '100%' on the front means nothing if the label says otherwise.

cards.body: You can complain about misleading ads yourself: National Consumer Helpline 1915, or the NCH app.
